pr_comments: With the current implementation, does the user's original setting is preserved after the restart?

It should because the current implementation is the same mechanism as when changing languages.
I'm currently working on further improvements to automatically restart the app without clicking notifications.

Automatic restart is now implemented.
When `Launcher.LaunchUriAsync()` is called, the method somehow doesn't return even though a new app is launched, so I use a timer to force it to end.

Notifications now doesn't launch the application when clicked in favor of automatic restart.

> When `Launcher.LaunchUriAsync()` is called, the method somehow doesn't return even though a new app is launched

It might be related with #3652

As it is, if I get an error when I view a particular page, I get endless restarts.

It needs a little more improvement.

> > When `Launcher.LaunchUriAsync()` is called, the method somehow doesn't return even though a new app is launched
> 
> It might be related with #3652

But it returns normally when changing language.

issue_context.title: Feature: Auto restore tabs if the app crashes
issue_context.body:
### What's the Problem?

With #5985, it will only remember the tabs of the last opened window, even if you have more than one opened.

### Requirements
Auto restore tabs on first launch after the app crashes

### Files Version

1.9.32.0 / #5985

### Windows Version

Windows 10 21H1 10.0.19043.1165

### Additional comment

_No response_
comments: Love this, there def needs to be improvements in state handling
@BanCrash do you want to implement this?

> @BanCrash do you want to implement this?

I look at this at the past and found it beyond my knowledge, but I can give it another try.

I think we already have some exception handling that logs errors so we should be able to save the current tab session and auto restart the app (take a look at the restart prompt on the preferences page).
@BanCrash thank you for your feedback, this has been implemented and will be included in one of the next feature releases.

review_comments: Are there any known situations where the app can get into a restart loop?
No. Not all crashes are handled with `AppUnhandledException`, but in which case the `LastSessionTabList` is updated to "Home" so that the crashed page is not displayed again.
This assignation is done several times through the class, why not hoilst it on top of it in `private readonly` field?
